items.q: How many languages do you support?
items.a: 100+ languages with native specialists across 30+ countries — including all major European, Asian, African, and Middle Eastern languages.
Yes — most of our clients combine two or more. Localization plus international SEO, or AI annotation plus multilingual datasets, are common pairings handled by one senior project lead.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day, share a scoped proposal within 24–48 hours, and most projects ship a first deliverable within two weeks.
Every program runs through a documented QA process: native-speaker review for language work, gold-set calibration and inter-annotator agreement for AI data, and clear reporting for SEO and marketing.
